_setup.description:
1. Open [DingTalk AI Hub](https://aihub.dingtalk.com/#/mcp)
2. Find **DingTalk 听记 (Meeting Notes) MCP**
3. Click to generate your personal configuration
4. Copy the JSON and paste it into the input box below
